title: Create 5 missing CriticEngine evaluators + register in engine
description: FIX-001 (HIGH): 5 evaluators planned but never created — PacingEvaluator, DialogueEvaluator, WorldBuildingEvaluator, ThemeEvaluator, ResearchEvaluator. Create each following the BaseEvaluator pattern, register in critic-engine.js with weights, add barrel exports to index.js.
action: Create 5 evaluator files in src-tauri/bin/sidecar/narrative/evaluators/ (pacing-evaluator.js, dialogue-evaluator.js, worldbuilding-evaluator.js, theme-evaluator.js, research-evaluator.js) each extending BaseEvaluator with static MARKER arrays, evaluate() returning EvaluationResult, and quickScan(). Register all 5 in critic-engine.js constructor (this.evaluators + this.weights). Add 5 barrel exports to index.js.

criteria: pacing-evaluator.js exists in src-tauri/bin/sidecar/narrative/evaluators/ and contains 'extends BaseEvaluator'
dialogue-evaluator.js exists in src-tauri/bin/sidecar/narrative/evaluators/ and contains 'extends BaseEvaluator'
worldbuilding-evaluator.js exists in src-tauri/bin/sidecar/narrative/evaluators/ and contains 'extends BaseEvaluator'
theme-evaluator.js exists in src-tauri/bin/sidecar/narrative/evaluators/ and contains 'extends BaseEvaluator'
research-evaluator.js exists in src-tauri/bin/sidecar/narrative/evaluators/ and contains 'extends BaseEvaluator'
critic-engine.js this.evaluators has exactly 13 entries (8 existing + 5 new, verified by counting this.evaluators[key] lines)
index.js contains 'export { PacingEvaluator }' and 'export { DialogueEvaluator }' and 'export { WorldBuildingEvaluator }' and 'export { ThemeEvaluator }' and 'export { ResearchEvaluator }'
Each evaluator file contains async evaluate(content, context) method returning new EvaluationResult
Each evaluator file contains quickScan(content) method
convergence.verification: Grep for each evaluator class name in critic-engine.js. Count this.evaluators registrations. Verify barrel exports in index.js. Run test suite.
convergence.definition_of_done: All 5 evaluators created with substantive evaluation logic, registered in CriticEngine with weights, and exported from barrel file

files.change: Create evaluator extending BaseEvaluator with MARKER arrays for pacing patterns (fast-slow transitions, scene breaks, time jumps, chapter beats). evaluate() scores rhythm variation, scene balance, tension pacing. Weight suggestion: 0.10.

Create evaluator extending BaseEvaluator with MARKER arrays for dialogue patterns (attribution variation, subtext indicators, speech tags, dialogue beats). evaluate() scores naturalism, attribution diversity, subtext density. Weight suggestion: 0.10.

Create evaluator extending BaseEvaluator with MARKER arrays for worldbuilding patterns (setting descriptions, sensory details, cultural references, place names). evaluate() scores setting density, sensory engagement, cultural depth. Weight suggestion: 0.08.

Create evaluator extending BaseEvaluator with MARKER arrays for thematic patterns (motif recurrence, symbolic language, philosophical terms, thematic contrasts). evaluate() scores thematic coherence, motif consistency, symbolic depth. Weight suggestion: 0.08.

Create evaluator extending BaseEvaluator with MARKER arrays for research quality (factual indicators, specificity markers, citation patterns, technical terminology). evaluate() scores factual grounding, specificity, terminology accuracy. Weight suggestion: 0.08.

Add 5 import statements at top for new evaluator classes. Add 5 this.evaluators[key] = new EvaluatorClass(config) registrations. Add 5 this.weights[key] = decimal entries (pacing: 0.10, dialogue: 0.10, worldbuilding: 0.08, theme: 0.08, research: 0.08).

Add 5 export lines: export { PacingEvaluator } from './pacing-evaluator.js', export { DialogueEvaluator } from './dialogue-evaluator.js', export { WorldBuildingEvaluator } from './worldbuilding-evaluator.js', export { ThemeEvaluator } from './theme-evaluator.js', export { ResearchEvaluator } from './research-evaluator.js'.

implementation: Read base.js to confirm BaseEvaluator API: constructor(config), get name(), get description(), get relatedSkill(), scoreToLevel(), EvaluationResult constructor(evaluatorName, score, level, issues, metrics, summary)
Read character-evaluator.js as reference implementation pattern (MARKER arrays, evaluate, quickScan, private scoring methods)

Create pacing-evaluator.js: class PacingEvaluator extends BaseEvaluator with name='pacing', static RHYTHM_MARKERS/SCENE_MARKERS/TENSION_MARKERS, evaluate() scoring rhythm_variation/scene_balance/tension_pacing → weighted totalScore, quickScan() returning lightweight scan

Create dialogue-evaluator.js: class DialogueEvaluator extends BaseEvaluator with name='dialogue', static ATTRIBUTION_MARKERS/SUBTEXT_MARKERS/SPEECH_MARKERS, evaluate() scoring naturalism/attribution_diversity/subtext_density, quickScan()

Create worldbuilding-evaluator.js: class WorldBuildingEvaluator extends BaseEvaluator with name='worldbuilding', static SETTING_MARKERS/SENSORY_MARKERS/CULTURAL_MARKERS, evaluate() scoring setting_density/sensory_engagement/cultural_depth, quickScan()

Create theme-evaluator.js: class ThemeEvaluator extends BaseEvaluator with name='theme', static MOTIF_MARKERS/SYMBOLIC_MARKERS/PHILOSOPHICAL_MARKERS, evaluate() scoring thematic_coherence/motif_consistency/symbolic_depth, quickScan()

Create research-evaluator.js: class ResearchEvaluator extends BaseEvaluator with name='research', static FACTUAL_MARKERS/SPECIFICITY_MARKERS/TECHNICAL_MARKERS, evaluate() scoring factual_grounding/specificity/terminology_accuracy, quickScan()
Modify critic-engine.js: add 5 import lines after existing imports, add 5 this.evaluators entries in constructor, add 5 this.weights entries
Modify index.js: add 5 barrel export lines after existing exports
Run npx vitest run to verify no regressions

unit: Each evaluator returns EvaluationResult with score/level/issues/metrics/summary
integration: CriticEngine.evaluate() runs all 13 evaluators without errors

reference.pattern: BaseEvaluator subclass pattern from character-evaluator.js: static MARKER arrays, evaluate() with weighted subscores, quickScan() with lightweight scan
reference.examples: CharacterEvaluator: MARKER arrays (PERSONALITY_MARKERS, RELATIONSHIP_MARKERS, etc.), evaluate() scoring personality/consistency/depth/arc with weighted combination, quickScan() returning quick scan result

rationale.chosen_approach: Create 5 substantive evaluators following exact BaseEvaluator pattern, not stubs
decision_factors: Verification C1/C2/C5 require evaluators with 'distinct evaluation logic (not stubs)'
Existing evaluators have 100-200 lines with real MARKER arrays and scoring logic
Weights kept low (0.08-0.10) since these supplement existing evaluators
rationale.tradeoffs: Each evaluator has MARKER-based heuristic scoring rather than LLM-based evaluation — consistent with existing pattern but less sophisticated than ML approaches

risks.risk: Evaluator scoring logic may produce unexpected results for edge cases
risks.mitigation: Follow marker-matching pattern from existing evaluators; run vitest to catch syntax/import errors
